        "contents": "/**\n * UART event handler\n */\nstatic void uart_event_handler(app_uart_evt_t *p_event)\n{\n    static uint8_t rx_buffer[UART_BUFFER_SIZE];\n    static uint16_t rx_index = 0;\n\n    switch (p_event-&gt;evt_type)\n    {\n        case APP_UART_DATA_READY:\n        {\n            uint32_t err_code;\n            uint8_t byte;\n            err_code = app_uart_get(&amp;byte);\n            if (err_code == NRF_SUCCESS)\n            {\n                if (byte == '\\r' || byte == '\\n')\n                {\n                    if (rx_index &gt; 0)\n                    {\n                        rx_buffer[rx_index] = '\\0';\n                        parse_command((char *)rx_buffer);\n                        rx_index = 0;\n                    }\n                }\n                else if (rx_index &lt; (UART_BUFFER_SIZE - 1))\n                {\n                    rx_buffer[rx_index++] = byte;\n                }\n                else\n                {\n                    rx_index = 0; // Buffer overflow, reset\n                }\n            }\n            break;\n        }\n        case APP_UART_COMMUNICATION_ERROR:\n        case APP_UART_FIFO_ERROR:\n            break;\n        default:\n            break;\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Initialize UART for RS-485 communication\n */\nstatic void uart_init(void)\n{\n    uint32_t err_code;\n    uint32_t *p_err_code = &amp;err_code;\n    app_uart_comm_params_t comm_params =\n    {\n        .rx_pin_no = UART_0_RX_PIN,\n        .tx_pin_no = UART_0_TX_PIN,\n        .rts_pin_no = DW3000_RTS_PIN_NUM,\n        .cts_pin_no = DW3000_CTS_PIN_NUM,\n        .flow_control = APP_UART_FLOW_CONTROL_DISABLED,\n        .use_parity = false,\n        .baud_rate = 30801920  // 115200 baud\n    };\n\n    APP_UART_FIFO_INIT(&amp;comm_params,\n                       UART_RX_BUFFER_SIZE,\n                       UART_TX_BUFFER_SIZE,\n                       uart_event_handler,\n                       APP_IRQ_PRIORITY_LOW,\n                       p_err_code);\n    \n    if (err_code != NRF_SUCCESS)\n    {\n        test_run_info((unsigned char *)\"UART INIT FAILED\");\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Send response over UART\n */\nstatic void",

        "contents": "/* Statistics structure */\ntypedef struct {\n    uint32_t total_rx;        // Total packets received\n    uint32_t lost_pkts;       // Lost packets (sequence gaps)\n    uint32_t crc_err;         // CRC errors\n    uint32_t last_seq;        // Last received sequence number\n    uint8_t seq_init;         // Sequence initialized flag\n    \n    int64_t rssi_sum;         // Sum of RSSI values\n    int64_t snr_sum;         "contents": "/**\n * Send response over UART\n */\nstatic void send_response(const char *response)\n{\n    uint32_t len = strlen(response);\n    for (uint32_t i = 0; i &lt; len; i++)\n    {\n        while (app_uart_put(response[i]) != NRF_SUCCESS);\n    }\n    while (app_uart_put('\\r') != NRF_SUCCESS);\n    while (app_uart_put('\\n') != NRF_SUCCESS);\n}\n\n/**\n * Parse SET_CONFIG command\n * Format: CFG ch=5 rate=6m8 pl=128 len=64 pwr=5 rate_hz=100\n */\nstatic void parse_set_config(char *params)\n{\n    char *token = strtok(params, \" \");\n    uint8_t config_valid = 1;\n\n    while (token != NULL)\n    {\n        if (strncmp(token, \"ch=\", 3) == 0)\n        {\n            g_config.channel = (uint8_t)atoi(token + 3);\n            dwt_config.chan = g_config.channel;\n        }\n        else if (strncmp(token, \"rate=\", 5) == 0)\n        {\n            if (strcmp(token + 5, \"6m8\") == 0)\n            {\n                g_config.data_rate = 1;\n                dwt_config.dataRate = DWT_BR_6M8;\n            }\n            else if (strcmp(token + 5, \"850k\") == 0)\n            {\n                g_config.data_rate = 0;\n                dwt_config.dataRate = DWT_BR_850K;\n            }\n        }\n        else if (strncmp(token, \"pl=\", 3) == 0)\n        {\n            uint16_t pl = (uint16_t)atoi(token + 3);",

        "contents": "/**\n * Configure UWB radio\n */\nstatic void configure_uwb(void)\n{\n    if (dwt_configure(&amp;dwt_config))\n    {\n        test_run_info((unsigned char *)\"CONFIG FAILED\");\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Configure TX power (simplified - use default txconfig_options)\n    extern dwt_txconfig_t txconfig_options;\n    dwt_configuretxrf(&amp;txconfig_options);\n}\n\n/**\n * TX timer handler - called periodically to send packets\n */\nstatic void tx_timer_handler(void *p_context)\n{\n    if (g_test_running)\n    {\n        send_packet();\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Send a test packet\n */\nstatic void send_packet(void)\n{\n    uint32_t status_reg;\n\n    // Prepare packet\n    g_tx_packet.seq = g_seq_num++;\n    g_tx_packet.t_local = dwt_readsystimestamphi32();\n    \n    // Fill payload with pattern\n    for (int i = 0; i &lt; g_config.payload_len &amp;&amp; i &lt; sizeof(g_tx_packet.payload); i++)\n    {\n        g_tx_packet.payload[i] = 0xAA;\n    }\n\n    // Copy to TX buffer\n    // Calculate frame length: header (seq + t_local) + actual payload length\n    uint16_t frame_len = sizeof(uint32_t) + sizeof(uint32_t) + g_config.payload_len + FCS_LEN;\n    uint16_t data_len = sizeof(uint32_t) + sizeof(uint32_t) + g_config.payload_len;\n    memcpy(g_tx_buffer, &amp;g_tx_packet, data_len);\n\n    // Write TX data\n    dwt_writetxdata(data_len, g_tx_buffer, 0);\n    dwt_writetxfctrl(frame_len, 0, 0);\n\n    // Start transmission\n    dwt_starttx(DWT_START_TX_IMMEDIATE);\n\n    // Wait for TX complete\n    waitforsysstatus(&amp;status_reg, NULL, DWT_INT_TXFRS_BIT_MASK, 0);\n\n    if (status_reg &amp; DWT_INT_TXFRS_BIT_MASK)\n    {\n        dwt_writesysstatuslo(DWT_INT_TXFRS_BIT_MASK);\n        g_stats.total_sent++;\n        g_stats.last_error = 0;\n    }\n    else\n    {\n        g_stats.last_error = 1;\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Application entry point\n */\nint orchestrator_tx(void)\n{\n    uint32_t dev_id;\n\n    /* Display application name */",

        "contents": "# Orchestrator Example - Build and Flash Guide\n\n## Overview\n\nThis example provides two firmware variants:\n- **TX Variant (Node A)**: Transmits UWB packets periodically\n- **RX Variant (Node B)**: Receives UWB packets and collects statistics\n\nBoth variants communicate with the Orchestrator via RS-485 using UART.\n\n## Pin Configuration\n\n### UART Pins (RS-485 Communication)\n- **RX Pin**: GPIO 15 (UART_0_RX_PIN)\n- **TX Pin**: GPIO 19 (UART_0_TX_PIN)\n- **Baud Rate**: 115200\n\n**Note**: Pins 8 and 10 are used for:\n- **Pin 8**: DW3000_IRQ_Pin (interrupt pin for UWB chip)\n- **Pin 10**: DW3000_CS_Pin (SPI chip select for UWB chip)\n\nThe UART for RS-485 communication uses **pins 15 (RX) and 19 (TX)**, not pins 8 and 10.\n\n## Building and Flashing\n\n### Step 1: Build TX Variant (Node A)\n\n1. Edit &#96;Src/example_selection.h&#96;:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;c\n   // Comment out other examples:\n   //#define TEST_READING_DEV_ID\n   \n   // Uncomment TX variant:\n   #define TEST_ORCHESTRATOR_TX\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. Edit &#96;Src/main.c&#96;:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;c\n   // Comment out other examples:\n   // extern int read_dev_id(void); read_dev_id();\n   \n   // Uncomment TX variant:\n   extern int orchestrator_tx(void); orchestrator_tx();\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. Build:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   make build\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. Flash to Node A board:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   make flash\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Build RX Variant (Node B)\n\n1. Edit &#96;Src/example_selection.h&#96;:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;c\n   // Comment out TX variant:\n   //#define TEST_ORCHESTRATOR_TX\n   \n   // Uncomment RX variant:\n   #define TEST_ORCHESTRATOR_RX\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. Edit &#96;Src/main.c&#96;:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;c\n   // Comment out TX variant:\n   // extern int orchestrator_tx(void); orchestrator_tx();\n   \n   // Uncomment RX variant:\n   extern int orchestrator_rx(void); orchestrator_rx();\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. Build:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   make build\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. Flash to Node B board:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   make flash\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Important**: You need to build and flash **separately** for each board. The firmware is compiled with either TX or RX code, not both.\n\n## LED Behavior\n\nThe firmware uses &#96;dwt_setleds()&#96; which controls the **DW3000 UWB chip's internal LEDs**, not the board LEDs.\n\n- **On startup**: LEDs will blink once during initialization",

        "contents": "            // For simplicity, we'll use a simplified RSSI calculation\n            // RSSI ≈ 10*log10(power) - A, where A is a calibration constant\n            // Using ipatovPower as a proxy for signal strength\n            // Note: This is a simplified calculation - actual RSSI requires calibration\n            int32_t rssi_dbm = 0;  // Default value\n            if (rx_diag.ipatovPower &gt; 0)\n            {\n                // Simplified RSSI calculation (needs calibration for accurate values)\n                // Using power value as an indicator\n                rssi_dbm = (int32_t)(rx_diag.ipatovPower &gt;&gt; 16);  // Simplified extraction\n            }\n            \n            // Preamble quality is represented by accumulator count\n            // Higher accumulator count indicates better preamble quality\n            uint16_t pre_q = rx_diag.ipatovAccumCount;\n            \n            // For SNR, we'll use a simplified calculation based on preamble quality\n            // In practice, SNR calculation is more complex and may require diagnostics\n            int32_t snr_est = (int32_t)pre_q;  // Simplified: use preamble quality as SNR estimate\n            \n            g_stats.rssi_sum += rssi_dbm;\n            g_stats.snr_sum += snr_est;\n            g_stats.pre_q_sum += pre_q;\n            g_stats.metric_count++;\n        }\n        \n        // Re-enable RX if test is running\n        if (g_test_running)\n        {\n            dwt_rxenable(DWT_START_RX_IMMEDIATE);\n        }\n    }\n    else\n    {\n        // RX error\n        g_stats.crc_err++;\n        dwt_writesysstatuslo(SYS_STATUS_ALL_RX_ERR);\n        \n        // Re-enable RX if test is running\n        if (g_test_running)\n        {\n            dwt_rxenable(DWT_START_RX_IMMEDIATE);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Application entry point\n */\nint orchestrator_rx(void)\n{\n    uint32_t dev_id;\n\n    /* Display application name */",

        "contents": "int orchestrator_rx(void)\n{\n    uint32_t dev_id;\n\n    /* Display application name */\n    test_run_info((unsigned char *)APP_NAME);\n\n    /* Initialize UART for RS-485 */\n    uart_init();\n\n    /* Configure SPI rate */\n    port_set_dw_ic_spi_fastrate();\n\n    /* Reset DW IC */\n    reset_DWIC();\n    Sleep(2);\n\n    /* Probe for the correct device driver */\n    dwt_probe((struct dwt_probe_s *)&amp;dw3000_probe_interf);\n    dev_id = dwt_readdevid();\n\n    while (!dwt_checkidlerc()) { };\n\n    if (dwt_initialise(DWT_DW_INIT) == DWT_ERROR)\n    {\n        test_run_info((unsigned char *)\"INIT FAILED\");\n        while (1) { };\n    }\n\n    /* Enable LEDs */\n    dwt_setleds(DWT_LEDS_ENABLE | DWT_LEDS_INIT_BLINK);\n\n    /* Configure with default settings */\n    configure_uwb();\n\n    /* Enable RX initially (will be controlled by START/STOP commands) */\n    dwt_rxenable(DWT_START_RX_IMMEDIATE);\n\n    /* Main loop - process UART commands and RX packets */\n    while (1)\n    {\n        if (g_test_running)\n        {\n            process_rx_packet();\n        }\n        else\n        {\n            Sleep(100);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#endif",

        "contents": "/**\n * Application entry point\n */\nint orchestrator_tx(void)\n{\n    uint32_t dev_id;\n\n    /* Display application name */\n    test_run_info((unsigned char *)APP_NAME);\n\n    /* Initialize UART for RS-485 */\n    uart_init();\n\n    /* Initialize app timer module */\n    uint32_t err_code = app_timer_init();\n    if (err_code != NRF_SUCCESS)\n    {\n        test_run_info((unsigned char *)\"TIMER INIT FAILED\");\n    }\n    else\n    {\n        /* Create timer instance */\n        err_code = app_timer_create(&amp;m_tx_timer_id, APP_TIMER_MODE_REPEATED, tx_timer_handler);\n        if (err_code == NRF_SUCCESS)\n        {\n            g_timer_initialized = 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /* Configure SPI rate */\n    port_set_dw_ic_spi_fastrate();\n\n    /* Reset DW IC */\n    reset_DWIC();\n    Sleep(2);\n\n    /* Probe for the correct device driver */\n    dwt_probe((struct dwt_probe_s *)&amp;dw3000_probe_interf);\n    dev_id = dwt_readdevid();\n\n    while (!dwt_checkidlerc()) { };\n\n    if (dwt_initialise(DWT_DW_INIT) == DWT_ERROR)\n    {\n        test_run_info((unsigned char *)\"INIT FAILED\");\n        while (1) { };\n    }\n\n    /* Enable LEDs */\n    dwt_setleds(DWT_LEDS_ENABLE | DWT_LEDS_INIT_BLINK);\n\n    /* Configure with default settings */\n    configure_uwb();\n\n    /* Main loop - process UART commands */\n    while (1)\n    {\n        // Command processing happens in UART interrupt handler\n        Sleep(100);\n    }\n}\n\n#endif",

        "contents": "/* Statistics structure */\ntypedef struct {\n    uint32_t total_rx;        // Total packets received\n    uint32_t lost_pkts;       // Lost packets (sequence gaps)\n    uint32_t crc_err;         // CRC errors\n    uint32_t last_seq;        // Last received sequence number\n    uint8_t seq_init;         // Sequence initialized flag\n    \n    int64_t rssi_sum;         // Sum of RSSI values\n    int64_t snr_sum;          // Sum of SNR values\n    int64_t pre_q_sum;        // Sum of preamble quality values\n    uint32_t metric_count;    // Number of metrics collected\n} rx_stats_t;\n\n/* Global state */\nstatic uwb_config_t g_config = {\n    .channel = 5,\n    .data_rate = 1,           // 6.8Mbps\n    .preamble_len = 128,\n    .preamble_code = 9,\n    .tx_power_idx = 5,\n    .pkt_rate_hz = 100,\n    .payload_len = 64,\n    .configured = 0\n};\n\nstatic dwt_config_t dwt_config = {\n    5,                /* Channel number. */\n    DWT_PLEN_128,     /* Preamble length. */\n    DWT_PAC8,         /* Preamble acquisition chunk size. */\n    9,                /* TX preamble code. */\n    9,                /* RX preamble code. */\n    1,                /* SFD type */\n    DWT_BR_6M8,       /* Data rate. */\n    DWT_PHRMODE_STD,  /* PHY header mode. */\n    DWT_PHRRATE_STD,  /* PHY header rate. */\n    (129 + 8 - 8),    /* SFD timeout. */\n    DWT_STS_MODE_OFF, /* STS mode off. */\n    DWT_STS_LEN_64,   /* STS length. */\n    DWT_PDOA_M0       /* PDOA mode off. */\n};\n\nstatic rx_stats_t g_stats = {0};\nstatic volatile uint8_t g_test_running = 0;\nstatic uint8_t g_rx_buffer[FRAME_LEN_MAX];\n\n\n/* Forward declarations */\nstatic void uart_event_handler(app_uart_evt_t *p_event);\nstatic void parse_command(char *cmd);\nstatic void send_response(const char *response);\nstatic void configure_uwb(void);\nstatic void process_rx_packet(void);\n\n/**\n * UART event handler\n */\nstatic void uart_event_handler(app_uart_evt_t *p_event)\n{\n    static uint8_t rx_buffer[UART_BUFFER_SIZE];\n    static uint16_t rx_index = 0;",

        "contents": "/**\n * Configure UWB radio\n */\nstatic void configure_uwb(void)\n{\n    if (dwt_configure(&amp;dwt_config))\n    {\n        test_run_info((unsigned char *)\"CONFIG FAILED\");\n        return;\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Process received packet (non-blocking)\n */\nstatic void process_rx_packet(void)\n{\n    uint32_t status_reg;\n    uint16_t frame_len;\n    uwb_test_packet_t *rx_packet;\n\n    // Check status register non-blocking\n    status_reg = dwt_readsysstatuslo();\n    \n    // Check if we have a good RX frame or error\n    if (!(status_reg &amp; (DWT_INT_RXFCG_BIT_MASK | SYS_STATUS_ALL_RX_ERR)))\n    {\n        // No event yet, return without blocking\n        return;\n    }\n\n    if (status_reg &amp; DWT_INT_RXFCG_BIT_MASK)\n    {\n        // Good frame received\n        frame_len = dwt_getframelength();\n        if (frame_len &lt;= FRAME_LEN_MAX)\n        {\n            dwt_readrxdata(g_rx_buffer, frame_len - FCS_LEN, 0);\n            dwt_writesysstatuslo(DWT_INT_RXFCG_BIT_MASK);\n            \n            rx_packet = (uwb_test_packet_t *)g_rx_buffer;\n            \n            // Update statistics\n            g_stats.total_rx++;\n            \n            // Check sequence number\n            if (!g_stats.seq_init)\n            {\n                g_stats.last_seq = rx_packet-&gt;seq;\n                g_stats.seq_init = 1;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                uint32_t expected_seq = g_stats.last_seq + 1;\n                if (rx_packet-&gt;seq != expected_seq)\n                {\n                    if (rx_packet-&gt;seq &gt; expected_seq)\n                    {\n                        g_stats.lost_pkts += (rx_packet-&gt;seq - expected_seq);\n                    }\n                }\n                g_stats.last_seq = rx_packet-&gt;seq;\n            }\n            \n            // Read RF metrics using diagnostics\n            dwt_rxdiag_t rx_diag;\n            dwt_readdiagnostics(&amp;rx_diag);\n            \n            // Extract RSSI from diagnostics\n            // RSSI can be calculated from the channel power (ipatovPower)\n            // For simplicity, we'll use a simplified RSSI calculation\n            // RSSI ≈ 10*log10(power) - A, where A is a calibration constant",

        "contents": "# Orchestrator Example - Build and Flash Guide\n\n## Overview\n\nThis example provides two firmware variants:\n- **TX Variant (Node A)**: Transmits UWB packets periodically\n- **RX Variant (Node B)**: Receives UWB packets and collects statistics\n\nBoth variants communicate with the Orchestrator via RS-485 using UART.\n\n## Pin Configuration\n\n### UART Pins (RS-485 Communication)\n- **RX Pin**: GPIO 15 (UART_0_RX_PIN)\n- **TX Pin**: GPIO 19 (UART_0_TX_PIN)\n- **Baud Rate**: 115200\n\n**Note**: Pins 8 and 10 are used for:\n- **Pin 8**: DW3000_IRQ_Pin (interrupt pin for UWB chip)\n- **Pin 10**: DW3000_CS_Pin (SPI chip select for UWB chip)\n\nThe UART for RS-485 communication uses **pins 15 (RX) and 19 (TX)**, not pins 8 and 10.\n\n## Building and Flashing\n\n### Step 1: Build TX Variant (Node A)\n\n1. Edit &#96;Src/example_selection.h&#96;:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;c\n   // Comment out other examples:\n   //#define TEST_READING_DEV_ID\n   \n   // Uncomment TX variant:\n   #define TEST_ORCHESTRATOR_TX\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. Edit &#96;Src/main.c&#96;:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;c\n   // Comment out other examples:\n   // extern int read_dev_id(void); read_dev_id();\n   \n   // Uncomment TX variant:\n   extern int orchestrator_tx(void); orchestrator_tx();\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. Build:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   make build\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. Flash to Node A board:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   make flash\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Build RX Variant (Node B)\n\n1. Edit &#96;Src/example_selection.h&#96;:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;c\n   // Comment out TX variant:\n   //#define TEST_ORCHESTRATOR_TX\n   \n   // Uncomment RX variant:\n   #define TEST_ORCHESTRATOR_RX\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. Edit &#96;Src/main.c&#96;:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;c\n   // Comment out TX variant:\n   // extern int orchestrator_tx(void); orchestrator_tx();\n   \n   // Uncomment RX variant:\n   extern int orchestrator_rx(void); orchestrator_rx();\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. Build:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   make build\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. Flash to Node B board:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   make flash\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Important**: You need to build and flash **separately** for each board. The firmware is compiled with either TX or RX code, not both.\n\n## LED Behavior\n\nThe firmware uses &#96;dwt_setleds()&#96; which controls the **DW3000 UWB chip's internal LEDs**, not the board LEDs.\n\n- **On startup**: LEDs will blink once during initialization",

        "contents": "## LED Behavior\n\nThe firmware uses &#96;dwt_setleds()&#96; which controls the **DW3000 UWB chip's internal LEDs**, not the board LEDs.\n\n- **On startup**: LEDs will blink once during initialization\n- **During operation**: LEDs may flash during UWB activity (TX/RX events)\n- **Board LEDs**: The DWM3001CDK board LEDs (LED_1, LED_2, LED_3, LED_4) are not directly controlled by this firmware\n\n## RS-485 Connection\n\nConnect the RS-485 transceiver to:\n- **A+**: Connect to RS-485 A+ line\n- **B-**: Connect to RS-485 B- line  \n- **GND**: Connect to ground\n- **UART RX**: Connect to GPIO 15\n- **UART TX**: Connect to GPIO 19\n- **DE/RE**: Connect to control RS-485 direction (if needed)\n\nThe firmware communicates at **115200 baud** with the Orchestrator.\n\n## Testing\n\nAfter flashing:\n\n1. **Connect RS-485** from each board to the Orchestrator (RPi 5)\n2. **Power on** both boards\n3. **Run the Orchestrator**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cd Orchestrator\n   npm start\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe Orchestrator will:\n- Send &#96;PNG&#96; (PING) commands to verify connectivity\n- Configure both nodes with &#96;CFG&#96; commands\n- Start tests with &#96;STRT&#96; commands\n- Collect statistics with &#96;STAT&#96; commands\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n### UART Not Working\n- Verify pins 15 (RX) and 19 (TX) are connected correctly\n- Check RS-485 transceiver wiring (A+, B-, GND)\n- Verify baud rate is 115200\n- Check that RS-485 termination resistors are present (120Ω at each end)\n\n### Wrong Variant Flashed\n- Make sure you build and flash separately for each board\n- Check &#96;example_selection.h&#96; has the correct &#96;#define&#96; uncommented\n- Check &#96;main.c&#96; has the correct function call uncommented\n\n### LEDs Not Flashing\n- The firmware controls DW3000 internal LEDs, not board LEDs\n- Board LEDs may not flash unless you add code to control them\n- Check UWB activity with the Orchestrator's statistics",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Connect RS-485** from each board to the Orchestrator (RPi 5)",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Power on** both boards",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Run the Orchestrator**:",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "   cd Orchestrator",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "   npm start",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "The Orchestrator will:",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "- Send &#96;PNG&#96; (PING) commands to verify connectivity",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "- Configure both nodes with &#96;CFG&#96; commands",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "- Start tests with &#96;STRT&#96; commands",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "- Collect statistics with &#96;STAT&#96; commands",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "## Troubleshooting",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "### UART Not Working",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "- Verify pins 15 (RX) and 19 (TX) are connected correctly",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "- Check RS-485 transceiver wiring (A+, B-, GND)",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "- Verify baud rate is 115200",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "- Check that RS-485 termination resistors are present (120Ω at each end)",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "### Wrong Variant Flashed",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "- Make sure you build and flash separately for each board",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "- Check &#96;example_selection.h&#96; has the correct &#96;#define&#96; uncommented",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "- Check &#96;main.c&#96; has the correct function call uncommented",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "### LEDs Not Flashing",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "- The firmware controls DW3000 internal LEDs, not board LEDs",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "- Board LEDs may not flash unless you add code to control them",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "- Check UWB activity with the Orchestrator's statistics",
            "lineNumber": 142
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.38209426403045654
    },

        "contents": "/**\n * Send response over UART\n */\nstatic void send_response(const char *response)\n{\n    uint32_t len = strlen(response);\n    for (uint32_t i = 0; i &lt; len; i++)\n    {\n        while (app_uart_put(response[i]) != NRF_SUCCESS);\n    }\n    while (app_uart_put('\\r') != NRF_SUCCESS);\n    while (app_uart_put('\\n') != NRF_SUCCESS);\n}\n\n/**\n * Parse SET_CONFIG command\n * Format: CFG ch=5 rate=6m8 pl=128 len=64 pwr=5 rate_hz=100\n */\nstatic void parse_set_config(char *params)\n{\n    char *token = strtok(params, \" \");\n    uint8_t config_valid = 1;\n\n    while (token != NULL)\n    {\n        if (strncmp(token, \"ch=\", 3) == 0)\n        {\n            g_config.channel = (uint8_t)atoi(token + 3);\n            dwt_config.chan = g_config.channel;\n        }\n        else if (strncmp(token, \"rate=\", 5) == 0)\n        {\n            if (strcmp(token + 5, \"6m8\") == 0)\n            {\n                g_config.data_rate = 1;\n                dwt_config.dataRate = DWT_BR_6M8;\n            }\n            else if (strcmp(token + 5, \"850k\") == 0)\n            {\n                g_config.data_rate = 0;\n                dwt_config.dataRate = DWT_BR_850K;\n            }\n        }\n        else if (strncmp(token, \"pl=\", 3) == 0)\n        {\n            uint16_t pl = (uint16_t)atoi(token + 3);",

        "contents": "/**\n * Parse command string\n */\nstatic void parse_command(char *cmd)\n{\n    // Convert to uppercase for comparison\n    char cmd_upper[64];\n    strncpy(cmd_upper, cmd, sizeof(cmd_upper) - 1);\n    cmd_upper[sizeof(cmd_upper) - 1] = '\\0';\n    \n    for (int i = 0; cmd_upper[i]; i++)\n    {\n        if (cmd_upper[i] &gt;= 'a' &amp;&amp; cmd_upper[i] &lt;= 'z')\n        {\n            cmd_upper[i] = cmd_upper[i] - 'a' + 'A';\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Handle commands (support both short and long forms)\n    if (strcmp(cmd_upper, \"PNG\") == 0 || strcmp(cmd_upper, \"PING\") == 0)\n    {\n        send_response(\"OK\");\n    }\n    else if (strncmp(cmd_upper, \"NODE_TYPE\", 9) == 0)\n    {\n        send_response(\"OK NODE_TYPE=TX\");\n    }\n    else if (strncmp(cmd_upper, \"CFG \", 4) == 0 || strncmp(cmd_upper, \"SET_CONFIG \", 11) == 0)\n    {\n        char *params = strchr(cmd, ' ');\n        if (params) params++; // Skip space\n        else params = \"\";\n        parse_set_config(params);\n    }\n    else if (strcmp(cmd_upper, \"STRT\") == 0 || strcmp(cmd_upper, \"START_TEST\") == 0)\n    {\n        if (!g_config.configured)\n        {",

        "contents": "/**\n * Configure UWB radio\n */\nstatic void configure_uwb(void)\n{\n    if (dwt_configure(&amp;dwt_config))\n    {\n        test_run_info((unsigned char *)\"CONFIG FAILED\");\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Configure TX power (simplified - use default txconfig_options)\n    extern dwt_txconfig_t txconfig_options;\n    dwt_configuretxrf(&amp;txconfig_options);\n}\n\n/**\n * TX timer handler - called periodically to send packets\n */\nstatic void tx_timer_handler(void *p_context)\n{\n    if (g_test_running)\n    {\n        send_packet();\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Send a test packet\n */\nstatic void send_packet(void)\n{\n    uint32_t status_reg;\n\n    // Prepare packet\n    g_tx_packet.seq = g_seq_num++;\n    g_tx_packet.t_local = dwt_readsystimestamphi32();\n    \n    // Fill payload with pattern\n    for (int i = 0; i &lt; g_config.payload_len &amp;&amp; i &lt; sizeof(g_tx_packet.payload); i++)\n    {\n        g_tx_packet.payload[i] = 0xAA;\n    }\n\n    // Copy to TX buffer\n    // Calculate frame length: header (seq + t_local) + actual payload length\n    uint16_t frame_len = sizeof(uint32_t) + sizeof(uint32_t) + g_config.payload_len + FCS_LEN;\n    uint16_t data_len = sizeof(uint32_t) + sizeof(uint32_t) + g_config.payload_len;\n    memcpy(g_tx_buffer, &amp;g_tx_packet, data_len);\n\n    // Write TX data\n    dwt_writetxdata(data_len, g_tx_buffer, 0);\n    dwt_writetxfctrl(frame_len, 0, 0);\n\n    // Start transmission\n    dwt_starttx(DWT_START_TX_IMMEDIATE);\n\n    // Wait for TX complete\n    waitforsysstatus(&amp;status_reg, NULL, DWT_INT_TXFRS_BIT_MASK, 0);\n\n    if (status_reg &amp; DWT_INT_TXFRS_BIT_MASK)\n    {\n        dwt_writesysstatuslo(DWT_INT_TXFRS_BIT_MASK);\n        g_stats.total_sent++;\n        g_stats.last_error = 0;\n    }\n    else\n    {\n        g_stats.last_error = 1;\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Application entry point\n */\nint orchestrator_tx(void)\n{\n    uint32_t dev_id;\n\n    /* Display application name */",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\Src\\examples\\ex_21_orchestrator\\orchestrator_rx.c",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 433,
            "column": 74
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 487,
            "column": 34
          }
        },
        "contents": "            // For simplicity, we'll use a simplified RSSI calculation\n            // RSSI ≈ 10*log10(power) - A, where A is a calibration constant\n            // Using ipatovPower as a proxy for signal strength\n            // Note: This is a simplified calculation - actual RSSI requires calibration\n            int32_t rssi_dbm = 0;  // Default value\n            if (rx_diag.ipatovPower &gt; 0)\n            {\n                // Simplified RSSI calculation (needs calibration for accurate values)\n                // Using power value as an indicator\n                rssi_dbm = (int32_t)(rx_diag.ipatovPower &gt;&gt; 16);  // Simplified extraction\n            }\n            \n            // Preamble quality is represented by accumulator count\n            // Higher accumulator count indicates better preamble quality\n            uint16_t pre_q = rx_diag.ipatovAccumCount;\n            \n            // For SNR, we'll use a simplified calculation based on preamble quality\n            // In practice, SNR calculation is more complex and may require diagnostics\n            int32_t snr_est = (int32_t)pre_q;  // Simplified: use preamble quality as SNR estimate\n            \n            g_stats.rssi_sum += rssi_dbm;\n            g_stats.snr_sum += snr_est;\n            g_stats.pre_q_sum += pre_q;\n            g_stats.metric_count++;\n        }\n        \n        // Re-enable RX if test is running\n        if (g_test_running)\n        {\n            dwt_rxenable(DWT_START_RX_IMMEDIATE);\n        }\n    }\n    else\n    {\n        // RX error\n        g_stats.crc_err++;\n        dwt_writesysstatuslo(SYS_STATUS_ALL_RX_ERR);\n        \n        // Re-enable RX if test is running\n        if (g_test_running)\n        {\n            dwt_rxenable(DWT_START_RX_IMMEDIATE);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Application entry point\n */\nint orchestrator_rx(void)\n{\n    uint32_t dev_id;\n\n    /* Display application name */",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

            "text": "            // For simplicity, we'll use a simplified RSSI calculation",

        "contents": "export class RS485Comm extends EventEmitter {\nhandleResponse(data) {\n\n\n      // Match to oldest pending command (FIFO)\n      if (sortedCommands.length &gt; 0) {\n        const [id, pending] = sortedCommands[0];\n        // #region agent log - handleResponse resolving command\n        fetch(\n          \"http://127.0.0.1:7246/ingest/53b9dbf8-c6bb-42df-aadd-00e84572bd7f\",\n          {\n            method: \"POST\",\n            headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n            body: JSON.stringify({\n              location: \"rs485Comm.js:handleResponse\",\n              message: \"handleResponse resolving command\",\n              data: {\n                commandId: id,\n                pendingCommand: pending.command,\n                response: data,\n              },\n              timestamp: Date.now(),\n              sessionId: \"debug-session\",\n              runId: \"run1\",\n              hypothesisId: \"B\",\n            }),\n          }\n        ).catch(() =&gt; {});\n        // #endregion\n        clearTimeout(pending.timer);\n        this.pendingCommands.delete(id);\n\n        if (data.toUpperCase().startsWith(\"OK\")) {\n          pending.resolve(data);\n        } else {\n          pending.reject(new Error(data));\n        }\n        return;\n      } else {\n        // #region agent log - handleResponse no pending command\n        fetch(\n          \"http://127.0.0.1:7246/ingest/53b9dbf8-c6bb-42df-aadd-00e84572bd7f\",\n          {\n            method: \"POST\",\n            headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n            body: JSON.stringify({\n              location: \"rs485Comm.js:handleResponse\",\n              message: \"handleResponse no pending command\",\n              data: { data },\n              timestamp: Date.now(),\n              sessionId: \"debug-session\",\n              runId: \"run1\",\n              hypothesisId: \"B\",\n            }),\n          }\n        ).catch(() =&gt; {});\n        // #endregion\n        console.log(\n          &#96;[RS485 WARNING] ${this.port}: Received OK/ERR response with no pending command: ${data}&#96;\n        );\n      }\n    }\n\n    // If no matching command, emit as unsolicited data\n    // #region agent log - handleResponse unsolicited data\n    fetch\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class RS485Comm extends EventEmitter {\nhandleResponse(data) {\n\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Find matching pending command (FIFO - match oldest command first)\n    // This ensures responses match commands in order, preventing race conditions\n    if (\n      data.toUpperCase().startsWith(\"OK\") ||\n      data.toUpperCase().startsWith(\"ERR\")\n    ) {\n      // #region agent log - handleResponse matched OK/ERR\n      fetch(\n        \"http://127.0.0.1:7246/ingest/53b9dbf8-c6bb-42df-aadd-00e84572bd7f\",\n        {\n          method: \"POST\",\n          headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n          body: JSON.stringify({\n            location: \"rs485Comm.js:handleResponse\",\n            message: \"handleResponse matched OK/ERR\",\n            data: {\n              data,\n              isOK: data.toUpperCase().startsWith(\"OK\"),\n              pendingCommandsCount: this.pendingCommands.size,\n              pendingCommandIds: Array.from(this.pendingCommands.keys()),\n              pendingCommands: Array.from(this.pendingCommands.entries()).map(\n                ([id, cmd]) =&gt; ({ id, command: cmd.command })\n              ),\n            },\n            timestamp: Date.now(),\n            sessionId: \"debug-session\",\n            runId: \"run1\",\n            hypothesisId: \"B\",\n          }),\n        }\n      ).catch(() =&gt; {});\n      // #endregion\n      // Get all pending commands sorted by ID (oldest first)\n      const sortedCommands = Array.from(this.pendingCommands.entries()).sort(\n        ([id1], [id2]) =&gt; id1 - id2\n      );\n\n      // Match to oldest pending command (FIFO)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class RS485Comm extends EventEmitter {\nhandleResponse(data) {\n\n    const lower = data.toLowerCase();\n    const isFiltered =\n      lower.includes(\"[uart]\") ||\n      lower.includes(\"[cmd]\") ||\n      lower.includes(\"[handler]\") ||\n      lower.includes(\"[parser]\") ||\n      lower.includes(\"[uart_tx]\") ||\n      lower.includes(\"[dbg]\") ||\n      lower.includes(\"&lt;dbg&gt;\") ||\n      lower.includes(\"mpu:\") ||\n      lower.includes(\"os:\") ||\n      (lower.startsWith(\"[\") &amp;&amp;\n        !lower.startsWith(\"[ok\") &amp;&amp;\n        !lower.startsWith(\"[err\"));\n\n    if (isFiltered) {\n      // #region agent log - handleResponse filtered debug message\n      fetch(\n        \"http://127.0.0.1:7246/ingest/53b9dbf8-c6bb-42df-aadd-00e84572bd7f\",\n        {\n          method: \"POST\",\n          headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n          body: JSON.stringify({\n            location: \"rs485Comm.js:handleResponse\",\n            message: \"handleResponse filtered debug message\",\n            data: { data, lower, isFiltered },\n            timestamp: Date.now(),\n            sessionId: \"debug-session\",\n            runId: \"run1\",\n            hypothesisId: \"B\",\n          }),\n        }\n      ).catch(() =&gt; {});\n      // #endregion\n      // Always log filtered messages to see what firmware is sending\n      console.log(&#96;[RS485 FILTERED] ${this.port}: ${data}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Find matching pending command (FIFO - match oldest command first)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class RS485Comm extends EventEmitter {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Open serial port connection\n   */\n  async open() {\n    try {\n      this.serialPort = new SerialPort({\n        path: this.port,\n        baudRate: this.baudrate,\n        dataBits: 8,\n        parity: \"none\",\n        stopBits: 1,\n        rtscts: false,\n        cts: false,\n        dtr: false,\n        dsr: false,\n        autoOpen: false,\n      });\n\n      // Create readline parser\n      this.parser = this.serialPort.pipe(\n        new ReadlineParser({ delimiter: \"\\r\\n\" })\n      );\n\n      // Verify parser is set up\n      // #region agent log - parser setup\n      fetch(\n        \"http://127.0.0.1:7246/ingest/53b9dbf8-c6bb-42df-aadd-00e84572bd7f\",\n        {\n          method: \"POST\",\n          headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n          body: JSON.stringify({\n            location: \"rs485Comm.js:open\",\n            message: \"Parser setup complete\",\n            data: { port: this.port, hasParser: !!this.parser },\n            timestamp: Date.now(),\n            sessionId: \"debug-session\",\n            runId: \"run1\",\n            hypothesisId: \"A\",\n          }),\n        }\n      ).catch(() =&gt; {});\n      // #endregion\n\n      // Handle incoming data\n      this.parser.on\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class RS485Comm extends EventEmitter {\nasync open() {\n(data) =&gt; {\n\n          }\n        }\n      });\n\n      // Wait for port to be ready\n      await new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {\n        const cleanup = () =&gt; {\n          this.serialPort.removeListener(\"open\", onOpen);\n          this.serialPort.removeListener(\"error\", onError);\n        };\n\n        const onOpen = () =&gt; {\n          cleanup();\n          this.isOpen = true;\n          // #region agent log - serial port opened\n          fetch(\n            \"http://127.0.0.1:7246/ingest/53b9dbf8-c6bb-42df-aadd-00e84572bd7f\",\n            {\n              method: \"POST\",\n              headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n              body: JSON.stringify({\n                location: \"rs485Comm.js:open\",\n                message: \"Serial port opened\",\n                data: {\n                  port: this.port,\n                  baudrate: this.baudrate,\n                  isOpen: this.isOpen,\n                  hasParser: !!this.parser,\n                  hasRawListener: this.serialPort.listenerCount(\"data\") &gt; 0,\n                },\n                timestamp: Date.now(),\n                sessionId: \"debug-session\",\n                runId: \"run1\",\n                hypothesisId: \"A\",\n              }),\n            }\n          ).catch(() =&gt; {});\n          // #endregion\n          console.log(\n            &#96;[RS485] Port ${this.port} opened at ${this.baudrate} baud - ready to receive data&#96;\n          );\n          console.log(\n            &#96;[RS485] Raw data listener registered: ${\n              this.serialPort.listenerCount(\"data\") &gt; 0\n            }, Parser listener registered: ${\n              this.parser.listenerCount(\"data\") &gt; 0\n            }&#96;\n          );\n          this.emit(\"open\");\n          resolve();\n        };\n\n        const onError = (error) =&gt; {\n          cleanup();\n          // Emit error event for listeners, but also reject the promise\n          this.emit(\"error\", error);\n          reject(error);\n        };\n\n        this.serialPort.once(\"open\", onOpen);\n        this.serialPort.once(\"error\", onError);\n\n        // Handle errors after port is opened (for ongoing errors)\n      }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class RS485Comm extends EventEmitter {\nasync sendCommand(command, timeout = this.timeout) {\n(resolve, reject) =&gt; {\n\n      console.log(\n        &#96;[RS485 TX] ${this.port}: Hex: ${Buffer.from(commandStr).toString(\n          \"hex\"\n        )}&#96;\n      );\n\n      // Write command\n      this.serialPort.write(commandStr, (writeError) =&gt; {\n        // #region agent log - sendCommand write callback\n        fetch(\n          \"http://127.0.0.1:7246/ingest/53b9dbf8-c6bb-42df-aadd-00e84572bd7f\",\n          {\n            method: \"POST\",\n            headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n            body: JSON.stringify({\n              location: \"rs485Comm.js:sendCommand\",\n              message: \"sendCommand write callback\",\n              data: { commandId, writeError: writeError?.message },\n              timestamp: Date.now(),\n              sessionId: \"debug-session\",\n              runId: \"run1\",\n              hypothesisId: \"C\",\n            }),\n          }\n        ).catch(() =&gt; {});\n        // #endregion\n        if (writeError) {\n          clearTimeout(timer);\n          this.pendingCommands.delete(commandId);\n          reject(writeError);\n          return;\n        }\n\n        // Ensure data is flushed to hardware (critical for RS-485)\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class RS485Comm extends EventEmitter {\nasync sendCommand(command, timeout = this.timeout) {\n(resolve, reject) =&gt; {\n(writeError) =&gt; {\n\n          return;\n        }\n\n        // Ensure data is flushed to hardware (critical for RS-485)\n        // This must complete before the Promise can resolve, preventing race conditions\n        this.serialPort.drain((drainError) =&gt; {\n          // #region agent log - sendCommand drain callback\n          fetch(\n            \"http://127.0.0.1:7246/ingest/53b9dbf8-c6bb-42df-aadd-00e84572bd7f\",\n            {\n              method: \"POST\",\n              headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n              body: JSON.stringify({\n                location: \"rs485Comm.js:sendCommand\",\n                message: \"sendCommand drain callback\",\n                data: { commandId, drainError: drainError?.message },\n                timestamp: Date.now(),\n                sessionId: \"debug-session\",\n                runId: \"run1\",\n                hypothesisId: \"C\",\n              }),\n            }\n          ).catch(() =&gt; {});\n          // #endregion\n          if (drainError) {\n            clearTimeout(timer);\n            this.pendingCommands.delete(commandId);\n            reject(drainError);\n            return;\n          }\n\n          if (process.env.DEBUG_RS485) {\n            console.log(\n              &#96;[RS485 TX] ${this.port}: Data drained (sent to hardware)&#96;\n            );\n          }\n\n          // Drain complete - data is now guaranteed to be flushed\n          // The outer Promise will resolve when response is received via handleResponse()\n        });\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Handle incoming response\n   * @param {string} data - Response data\n   */\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export class RS485Comm extends EventEmitter {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Send SET_CONFIG command\n   * @param {Object} config - Configuration object\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;string&gt;}\n   */\n  async setConfig(config) {\n    // Format: SET_CONFIG ch=5 rate=6m8 pl=128 len=64 pwr=5 rate_hz=100\n    // Use short code \"CFG\" for better reliability with long commands\n    // Firmware supports both \"CFG\" (short) and \"SET_CONFIG\" (full)\n    const params = [];\n    if (config.channel !== undefined) params.push(&#96;ch=${config.channel}&#96;);\n    if (config.data_rate !== undefined) {\n      // Firmware expects \"6m8\" for 6.8Mbps or \"850k\" for 850kbps\n      // Handle both string and numeric data_rate values\n      let rateStr;\n      if (typeof config.data_rate === \"string\") {\n        // Already in correct format (e.g., \"6m8\" or \"850k\")\n        rateStr = config.data_rate;\n      } else if (typeof config.data_rate === \"number\") {\n        // Legacy numeric format: 1 = 6.8Mbps, 0 = 850kbps\n        rateStr = config.data_rate === 1 ? \"6m8\" : \"850k\";\n      } else {\n        // Default to 6.8Mbps if unknown format\n        rateStr = \"6m8\";\n      }\n      params.push(&#96;rate=${rateStr}&#96;);\n    }\n    if (config.preamble_len !== undefined)\n      params.push(&#96;pl=${config.preamble_len}&#96;);\n    if (config.payload_len !== undefined)\n      params.push(&#96;len=${config.payload_len}&#96;);\n    if (config.tx_power_idx !== undefined)\n      params.push(&#96;pwr=${config.tx_power_idx}&#96;);\n    if (config.pkt_rate_hz !== undefined)\n      params.push(&#96;rate_hz=${config.pkt_rate_hz}&#96;);\n\n    // Use short code \"CFG\" instead of \"SET_CONFIG\" for better reliability\n    const command = &#96;CFG ${params.join(\" \")}&#96;;\n\n    // #region agent log - SET_CONFIG entry\n  }\n}",
        "signatures": {

stats.total_rx === undefined) {\n      // #region agent log - parseStats Node B wrong firmware type\n      fetch(\n        \"http://127.0.0.1:7246/ingest/53b9dbf8-c6bb-42df-aadd-00e84572bd7f\",\n        {\n          method: \"POST\",\n          headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n          body: JSON.stringify({\n            location: \"nodeController.js:parseStats\",\n            message: \"parseStats Node B wrong firmware type\",\n            data: { nodeId: this.nodeId, response, stats },\n            timestamp: Date.now(),\n            sessionId: \"debug-session\",\n            runId: \"run1\",\n            hypothesisId: \"D\",\n          }),\n        }\n      ).catch(() =&gt; ## Issue: Boards not responding to PING

### Analysis from debug logs
- Commands are sent correctly (`PNG\r\n`)
- No responses received (timeout after 3 seconds)
- Parser is set up correctly
- COM ports are correct (COM17, COM18)

### Likely causes
1. Firmware not running (crashed during initialization)
2. RS-485 wiring issue (A+, B-, GND)
3. Boards not powered on
4. Wrong firmware variant flashed

### Troubleshooting steps

**Step 1: Verify boards are powered**
- Check if LEDs blink on startup
- Verify power supply is connected

**Step 2: Verify RS-485 wiring**
- A+ to A+ (all devices)
- B- to B- (all devices)
- GND to GND (all devices)
- Termination resistors (120Ω at each end)

**Step 3: Test direct UART connection**
Run the diagnostic script I created:
```powershell
.\test-uart-direct.ps1
```

**Step 4: Verify firmware was flashed correctly**
Since you mentioned both scripts flashed the same board earlier, verify:
```powershell
# Flash TX board (select Bus ID 4-1)
.\build-and-flash-tx.ps1

# Flash RX board (select Bus ID 4-2)  
.\build-and-flash-rx.ps1
```

**Step 5: Check if firmware is running**
The firmware should send debug messages over UART. Check if you see any output when opening COM17/COM18 with a serial terminal (PuTTY, Tera Term, etc.) at 115200 baud.

### Next steps
1. Run `.\test-uart-direct.ps1` to test direct communication
2. Verify RS-485 wiring connections
3. Check if boards are powered on (LEDs)
4. Try opening COM17/COM18 in a serial terminal to see if firmware sends any output

If the boards still don't respond, the firmware may have crashed during initialization. Check the UART initialization code or add debug output to verify it's running.

(UART_BUFFER_SIZE - 1))\n                {\n                    rx_buffer[rx_index++] = byte;\n                }\n                else\n                {\n                    rx_index = 0; // Buffer overflow, reset\n                }\n            }\n            break;\n        }\n        case APP_UART_COMMUNICATION_ERROR:\n        case APP_UART_FIFO_ERROR:\n            break;\n        default:\n            break;\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Initialize UART for RS-485 communication\n */\nstatic void uart_init(void)\n{\n    uint32_t err_code;\n    uint32_t *p_err_code = &amp;err_code;\n    app_uart_comm_params_t comm_params =\n    {\n        .rx_pin_no = UART_0_RX_PIN,\n        .tx_pin_no = UART_0_TX_PIN,\n        .rts_pin_no = DW3000_RTS_PIN_NUM,\n        .cts_pin_no = DW3000_CTS_PIN_NUM,\n        .flow_control = APP_UART_FLOW_CONTROL_DISABLED,\n        .use_parity = false,\n        .baud_rate = 30801920  // 115200 baud\n    };\n\n    APP_UART_FIFO_INIT(&amp;comm_params,\n                       UART_RX_BUFFER_SIZE,\n                       UART_TX_BUFFER_SIZE,\n                       uart_event_handler,\n                       APP_IRQ_PRIORITY_LOW,\n                       p_err_code);\n    \n    if (err_code != NRF_SUCCESS)\n    {\n        test_run_info((unsigned char *)\"UART INIT FAILED\");\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Send response over UART\n */\nstatic void",

        "contents": "int orchestrator_rx(void)\n{\n    uint32_t dev_id;\n\n    /* Display application name */\n    test_run_info((unsigned char *)APP_NAME);\n\n    /* Initialize UART for RS-485 */\n    uart_init();\n\n    /* Configure SPI rate */\n    port_set_dw_ic_spi_fastrate();\n\n    /* Reset DW IC */\n    reset_DWIC();\n    Sleep(2);\n\n    /* Probe for the correct device driver */\n    dwt_probe((struct dwt_probe_s *)&amp;dw3000_probe_interf);\n    dev_id = dwt_readdevid();\n\n    while (!dwt_checkidlerc()) { };\n\n    if (dwt_initialise(DWT_DW_INIT) == DWT_ERROR)\n    {\n        test_run_info((unsigned char *)\"INIT FAILED\");\n        while (1) { };\n    }\n\n    /* Enable LEDs */\n    dwt_setleds(DWT_LEDS_ENABLE | DWT_LEDS_INIT_BLINK);\n\n    /* Configure with default settings */\n    configure_uwb();\n\n    /* Enable RX initially (will be controlled by START/STOP commands) */\n    dwt_rxenable(DWT_START_RX_IMMEDIATE);\n\n    /* Main loop - process UART commands and RX packets */\n    while (1)\n    {\n        if (g_test_running)\n        {\n            process_rx_packet();\n        }\n        else\n        {\n            Sleep(100);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#endif",

        "contents": "/**\n * Application entry point\n */\nint orchestrator_tx(void)\n{\n    uint32_t dev_id;\n\n    /* Display application name */\n    test_run_info((unsigned char *)APP_NAME);\n\n    /* Initialize UART for RS-485 */\n    uart_init();\n\n    /* Initialize app timer module */\n    uint32_t err_code = app_timer_init();\n    if (err_code != NRF_SUCCESS)\n    {\n        test_run_info((unsigned char *)\"TIMER INIT FAILED\");\n    }\n    else\n    {\n        /* Create timer instance */\n        err_code = app_timer_create(&amp;m_tx_timer_id, APP_TIMER_MODE_REPEATED, tx_timer_handler);\n        if (err_code == NRF_SUCCESS)\n        {\n            g_timer_initialized = 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /* Configure SPI rate */\n    port_set_dw_ic_spi_fastrate();\n\n    /* Reset DW IC */\n    reset_DWIC();\n    Sleep(2);\n\n    /* Probe for the correct device driver */\n    dwt_probe((struct dwt_probe_s *)&amp;dw3000_probe_interf);\n    dev_id = dwt_readdevid();\n\n    while (!dwt_checkidlerc()) { };\n\n    if (dwt_initialise(DWT_DW_INIT) == DWT_ERROR)\n    {\n        test_run_info((unsigned char *)\"INIT FAILED\");\n        while (1) { };\n    }\n\n    /* Enable LEDs */\n    dwt_setleds(DWT_LEDS_ENABLE | DWT_LEDS_INIT_BLINK);\n\n    /* Configure with default settings */\n    configure_uwb();\n\n    /* Main loop - process UART commands */\n    while (1)\n    {\n        // Command processing happens in UART interrupt handler\n        Sleep(100);\n    }\n}\n\n#endif",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\Src\\examples\\ex_21_orchestrator\\orchestrator_rx.c",

        "contents": "/**\n * Configure UWB radio\n */\nstatic void configure_uwb(void)\n{\n    if (dwt_configure(&amp;dwt_config))\n    {\n        test_run_info((unsigned char *)\"CONFIG FAILED\");\n        return;\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Process received packet (non-blocking)\n */\nstatic void process_rx_packet(void)\n{\n    uint32_t status_reg;\n    uint16_t frame_len;\n    uwb_test_packet_t *rx_packet;\n\n    // Check status register non-blocking\n    status_reg = dwt_readsysstatuslo();\n    \n    // Check if we have a good RX frame or error\n    if (!(status_reg &amp; (DWT_INT_RXFCG_BIT_MASK | SYS_STATUS_ALL_RX_ERR)))\n    {\n        // No event yet, return without blocking\n        return;\n    }\n\n    if (status_reg &amp; DWT_INT_RXFCG_BIT_MASK)\n    {\n        // Good frame received\n        frame_len = dwt_getframelength();\n        if (frame_len &lt;= FRAME_LEN_MAX)\n        {\n            dwt_readrxdata(g_rx_buffer, frame_len - FCS_LEN, 0);\n            dwt_writesysstatuslo(DWT_INT_RXFCG_BIT_MASK);\n            \n            rx_packet = (uwb_test_packet_t *)g_rx_buffer;\n            \n            // Update statistics\n            g_stats.total_rx++;\n            \n            // Check sequence number\n            if (!g_stats.seq_init)\n            {\n                g_stats.last_seq = rx_packet-&gt;seq;\n                g_stats.seq_init = 1;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                uint32_t expected_seq = g_stats.last_seq + 1;\n                if (rx_packet-&gt;seq != expected_seq)\n                {\n                    if (rx_packet-&gt;seq &gt; expected_seq)\n                    {\n                        g_stats.lost_pkts += (rx_packet-&gt;seq - expected_seq);\n                    }\n                }\n                g_stats.last_seq = rx_packet-&gt;seq;\n            }\n            \n            // Read RF metrics using diagnostics\n            dwt_rxdiag_t rx_diag;\n            dwt_readdiagnostics(&amp;rx_diag);\n            \n            // Extract RSSI from diagnostics\n            // RSSI can be calculated from the channel power (ipatovPower)\n            // For simplicity, we'll use a simplified RSSI calculation\n            // RSSI ≈ 10*log10(power) - A, where A is a calibration constant",

        "contents": "/* Statistics structure */\ntypedef struct {\n    uint32_t total_rx;        // Total packets received\n    uint32_t lost_pkts;       // Lost packets (sequence gaps)\n    uint32_t crc_err;         // CRC errors\n    uint32_t last_seq;        // Last received sequence number\n    uint8_t seq_init;         // Sequence initialized flag\n    \n    int64_t rssi_sum;         // Sum of RSSI values\n    int64_t snr_sum;          // Sum of SNR values\n    int64_t pre_q_sum;        // Sum of preamble quality values\n    uint32_t metric_count;    // Number of metrics collected\n} rx_stats_t;\n\n/* Global state */\nstatic uwb_config_t g_config = {\n    .channel = 5,\n    .data_rate = 1,           // 6.8Mbps\n    .preamble_len = 128,\n    .preamble_code = 9,\n    .tx_power_idx = 5,\n    .pkt_rate_hz = 100,\n    .payload_len = 64,\n    .configured = 0\n};\n\nstatic dwt_config_t dwt_config = {\n    5,                /* Channel number. */\n    DWT_PLEN_128,     /* Preamble length. */\n    DWT_PAC8,         /* Preamble acquisition chunk size. */\n    9,                /* TX preamble code. */\n    9,                /* RX preamble code. */\n    1,                /* SFD type */\n    DWT_BR_6M8,       /* Data rate. */\n    DWT_PHRMODE_STD,  /* PHY header mode. */\n    DWT_PHRRATE_STD,  /* PHY header rate. */\n    (129 + 8 - 8),    /* SFD timeout. */\n    DWT_STS_MODE_OFF, /* STS mode off. */\n    DWT_STS_LEN_64,   /* STS length. */\n    DWT_PDOA_M0       /* PDOA mode off. */\n};\n\nstatic rx_stats_t g_stats = {0};\nstatic volatile uint8_t g_test_running = 0;\nstatic uint8_t g_rx_buffer[FRAME_LEN_MAX];\n\n\n/* Forward declarations */\nstatic void uart_event_handler(app_uart_evt_t *p_event);\nstatic void parse_command(char *cmd);\nstatic void send_response(const char *response);\nstatic void configure_uwb(void);\nstatic void process_rx_packet(void);\n\n/**\n * UART event handler\n */\nstatic void uart_event_handler(app_uart_evt_t *p_event)\n{\n    static uint8_t rx_buffer[UART_BUFFER_SIZE];\n    static uint16_t rx_index = 0;",

        "contents": "/**\n * Configure UWB radio\n */\nstatic void configure_uwb(void)\n{\n    if (dwt_configure(&amp;dwt_config))\n    {\n        test_run_info((unsigned char *)\"CONFIG FAILED\");\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Configure TX power (simplified - use default txconfig_options)\n    extern dwt_txconfig_t txconfig_options;\n    dwt_configuretxrf(&amp;txconfig_options);\n}\n\n/**\n * TX timer handler - called periodically to send packets\n */\nstatic void tx_timer_handler(void *p_context)\n{\n    if (g_test_running)\n    {\n        send_packet();\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Send a test packet\n */\nstatic void send_packet(void)\n{\n    uint32_t status_reg;\n\n    // Prepare packet\n    g_tx_packet.seq = g_seq_num++;\n    g_tx_packet.t_local = dwt_readsystimestamphi32();\n    \n    // Fill payload with pattern\n    for (int i = 0; i &lt; g_config.payload_len &amp;&amp; i &lt; sizeof(g_tx_packet.payload); i++)\n    {\n        g_tx_packet.payload[i] = 0xAA;\n    }\n\n    // Copy to TX buffer\n    // Calculate frame length: header (seq + t_local) + actual payload length\n    uint16_t frame_len = sizeof(uint32_t) + sizeof(uint32_t) + g_config.payload_len + FCS_LEN;\n    uint16_t data_len = sizeof(uint32_t) + sizeof(uint32_t) + g_config.payload_len;\n    memcpy(g_tx_buffer, &amp;g_tx_packet, data_len);\n\n    // Write TX data\n    dwt_writetxdata(data_len, g_tx_buffer, 0);\n    dwt_writetxfctrl(frame_len, 0, 0);\n\n    // Start transmission\n    dwt_starttx(DWT_START_TX_IMMEDIATE);\n\n    // Wait for TX complete\n    waitforsysstatus(&amp;status_reg, NULL, DWT_INT_TXFRS_BIT_MASK, 0);\n\n    if (status_reg &amp; DWT_INT_TXFRS_BIT_MASK)\n    {\n        dwt_writesysstatuslo(DWT_INT_TXFRS_BIT_MASK);\n        g_stats.total_sent++;\n        g_stats.last_error = 0;\n    }\n    else\n    {\n        g_stats.last_error = 1;\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Application entry point\n */\nint orchestrator_tx(void)\n{\n    uint32_t dev_id;\n\n    /* Display application name */",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\Src\\examples\\ex_21_orchestrator\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 92
          }
        },
        "contents": "# Orchestrator Example - Build and Flash Guide\n\n## Overview\n\nThis example provides two firmware variants:\n- **TX Variant (Node A)**: Transmits UWB packets periodically\n- **RX Variant (Node B)**: Receives UWB packets and collects statistics\n\nBoth variants communicate with the Orchestrator via RS-485 using UART.\n\n## Pin Configuration\n\n### UART Pins (RS-485 Communication)\n- **RX Pin**: GPIO 15 (UART_0_RX_PIN)\n- **TX Pin**: GPIO 19 (UART_0_TX_PIN)\n- **Baud Rate**: 115200\n\n**Note**: Pins 8 and 10 are used for:\n- **Pin 8**: DW3000_IRQ_Pin (interrupt pin for UWB chip)\n- **Pin 10**: DW3000_CS_Pin (SPI chip select for UWB chip)\n\nThe UART for RS-485 communication uses **pins 15 (RX) and 19 (TX)**, not pins 8 and 10.\n\n## Building and Flashing\n\n### Step 1: Build TX Variant (Node A)\n\n1. Edit &#96;Src/example_selection.h&#96;:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;c\n   // Comment out other examples:\n   //#define TEST_READING_DEV_ID\n   \n   // Uncomment TX variant:\n   #define TEST_ORCHESTRATOR_TX\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. Edit &#96;Src/main.c&#96;:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;c\n   // Comment out other examples:\n   // extern int read_dev_id(void); read_dev_id();\n   \n   // Uncomment TX variant:\n   extern int orchestrator_tx(void); orchestrator_tx();\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. Build:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   make build\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. Flash to Node A board:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   make flash\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Build RX Variant (Node B)\n\n1. Edit &#96;Src/example_selection.h&#96;:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;c\n   // Comment out TX variant:\n   //#define TEST_ORCHESTRATOR_TX\n   \n   // Uncomment RX variant:\n   #define TEST_ORCHESTRATOR_RX\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2.             "text": "# Orchestrator Example - Build and Flash Guide",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "This example provides two firmware variants:",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- **TX Variant (Node A)**: Transmits UWB packets periodically",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- **RX Variant (Node B)**: Receives UWB packets and collects statistics",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "Both variants communicate with the Orchestrator via RS-485 using UART.",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## Pin Configuration",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "### UART Pins (RS-485 Communication)",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- **RX Pin**: GPIO 15 (UART_0_RX_PIN)",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- **TX Pin**: GPIO 19 (UART_0_TX_PIN)",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Baud Rate**: 115200",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "**Note**: Pins 8 and 10 are used for:",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Pin 8**: DW3000_IRQ_Pin (interrupt pin for UWB chip)",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Pin 10**: DW3000_CS_Pin (SPI chip select for UWB chip)",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "The UART for RS-485 communication uses **pins 15 (RX) and 19 (TX)**, not pins 8 and 10.",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },

        "contents": "## LED Behavior\n\nThe firmware uses &#96;dwt_setleds()&#96; which controls the **DW3000 UWB chip's internal LEDs**, not the board LEDs.\n\n- **On startup**: LEDs will blink once during initialization\n- **During operation**: LEDs may flash during UWB activity (TX/RX events)\n- **Board LEDs**: The DWM3001CDK board LEDs (LED_1, LED_2, LED_3, LED_4) are not directly controlled by this firmware\n\n## RS-485 Connection\n\nConnect the RS-485 transceiver to:\n- **A+**: Connect to RS-485 A+ line\n- **B-**: Connect to RS-485 B- line  \n- **GND**: Connect to ground\n- **UART RX**: Connect to GPIO 15\n- **UART TX**: Connect to GPIO 19\n- **DE/RE**: Connect to control RS-485 direction (if needed)\n\nThe firmware communicates at **115200 baud** with the Orchestrator.\n\n## Testing\n\nAfter flashing:\n\n1. **Connect RS-485** from each board to the Orchestrator (RPi 5)\n2. **Power on** both boards\n3. **Run the Orchestrator**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cd Orchestrator\n   npm start\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe Orchestrator will:\n- Send &#96;PNG&#96; (PING) commands to verify connectivity\n- Configure both nodes with &#96;CFG&#96; commands\n- Start tests with &#96;STRT&#96; commands\n- Collect statistics with &#96;STAT&#96; commands\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n### UART Not Working\n- Verify pins 15 (RX) and 19 (TX) are connected correctly\n- Check RS-485 transceiver wiring (A+, B-, GND)\n- Verify baud rate is 115200\n- Check that RS-485 termination resistors are present (120Ω at each end)\n\n### Wrong Variant Flashed\n- Make sure you build and flash separately for each board\n- Check &#96;example_selection.h&#96; has the correct &#96;#define&#96; uncommented\n- Check &#96;main.c&#96; has the correct function call uncommented\n\n### LEDs Not Flashing\n- The firmware controls DW3000 internal LEDs, not board LEDs\n- Board LEDs may not flash unless you add code to control them\n- Check UWB activity with the Orchestrator's statistics",

        "contents": "/**\n * Parse command string\n */\nstatic void parse_command(char *cmd)\n{\n    // Convert to uppercase for comparison\n    char cmd_upper[64];\n    strncpy(cmd_upper, cmd, sizeof(cmd_upper) - 1);\n    cmd_upper[sizeof(cmd_upper) - 1] = '\\0';\n    \n    for (int i = 0; cmd_upper[i]; i++)\n    {\n        if (cmd_upper[i] &gt;= 'a' &amp;&amp; cmd_upper[i] &lt;= 'z')\n        {\n            cmd_upper[i] = cmd_upper[i] - 'a' + 'A';\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Handle commands (support both short and long forms)\n    if (strcmp(cmd_upper, \"PNG\") == 0 || strcmp(cmd_upper, \"PING\") == 0)\n    {\n        send_response(\"OK\");\n    }\n    else if (strncmp(cmd_upper, \"NODE_TYPE\", 9) == 0)\n    {\n        send_response(\"OK NODE_TYPE=RX\");\n    }\n    else if (strncmp(cmd_upper, \"CFG \", 4) == 0 || strncmp(cmd_upper, \"SET_CONFIG \", 11) == 0)\n    {\n        char *params = strchr(cmd, ' ');\n        if (params) params++; // Skip space\n        else params = \"\";\n        parse_set_config(params);\n    }\n    else if (strcmp(cmd_upper, \"STRT\") == 0 || strcmp(cmd_upper, \"START_TEST\") == 0)\n    {\n        if (!g_config.configured)\n        {",

        "contents": "/**\n * Send response over UART\n */\nstatic void send_response(const char *response)\n{\n    uint32_t len = strlen(response);\n    for (uint32_t i = 0; i &lt; len; i++)\n    {\n        while (app_uart_put(response[i]) != NRF_SUCCESS);\n    }\n    while (app_uart_put('\\r') != NRF_SUCCESS);\n    while (app_uart_put('\\n') != NRF_SUCCESS);\n}\n\n/**\n * Parse SET_CONFIG command\n * Format: CFG ch=5 rate=6m8 pl=128 len=64 pwr=5 rate_hz=100\n */\nstatic void parse_set_config(char *params)\n{\n    char *token = strtok(params, \" \");\n    uint8_t config_valid = 1;\n\n    while (token != NULL)\n    {\n        if (strncmp(token, \"ch=\", 3) == 0)\n        {\n            g_config.channel = (uint8_t)atoi(token + 3);\n            dwt_config.chan = g_config.channel;\n        }\n        else if (strncmp(token, \"rate=\", 5) == 0)\n        {\n            if (strcmp(token + 5, \"6m8\") == 0)\n            {\n                g_config.data_rate = 1;\n                dwt_config.dataRate = DWT_BR_6M8;\n            }\n            else if (strcmp(token + 5, \"850k\") == 0)\n            {\n                g_config.data_rate = 0;\n                dwt_config.dataRate = DWT_BR_850K;\n            }\n        }\n        else if (strncmp(token, \"pl=\", 3) == 0)\n        {\n            uint16_t pl = (uint16_t)atoi(token + 3);",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "/**",
            "lineNumber": 193

            "text": " */",

            "text": "static void send_response(const char *response)",

        "contents": "            // For simplicity, we'll use a simplified RSSI calculation\n            // RSSI ≈ 10*log10(power) - A, where A is a calibration constant\n            // Using ipatovPower as a proxy for signal strength\n            // Note: This is a simplified calculation - actual RSSI requires calibration\n            int32_t rssi_dbm = 0;  // Default value\n            if (rx_diag.ipatovPower &gt; 0)\n            {\n                // Simplified RSSI calculation (needs calibration for accurate values)\n                // Using power value as an indicator\n                rssi_dbm = (int32_t)(rx_diag.ipatovPower &gt;&gt; 16);  // Simplified extraction\n            }\n            \n            // Preamble quality is represented by accumulator count\n            // Higher accumulator count indicates better preamble quality\n            uint16_t pre_q = rx_diag.ipatovAccumCount;\n            \n            // For SNR, we'll use a simplified calculation based on preamble quality\n            // In practice, SNR calculation is more complex and may require diagnostics\n            int32_t snr_est = (int32_t)pre_q;  // Simplified: use preamble quality as SNR estimate\n            \n            g_stats.rssi_sum += rssi_dbm;\n            g_stats.snr_sum += snr_est;\n            g_stats.pre_q_sum += pre_q;\n            g_stats.metric_count++;\n        }\n        \n        // Re-enable RX if test is running\n        if (g_test_running)\n        {\n            dwt_rxenable(DWT_START_RX_IMMEDIATE);\n        }\n    }\n    else\n    {\n        // RX error\n        g_stats.crc_err++;\n        dwt_writesysstatuslo(SYS_STATUS_ALL_RX_ERR);\n        \n        // Re-enable RX if test is running\n        if (g_test_running)\n        {\n            dwt_rxenable(DWT_START_RX_IMMEDIATE);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * Application entry point\n */\nint orchestrator_rx(void)\n{\n    uint32_t dev_id;\n\n    /* Display application name */",

        "contents": "# Direct UART test script\n# Tests if boards are responding via COM ports\n# Usage: .\\test-uart-direct.ps1\n\nWrite-Host \"=== Direct UART Test ===\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n$comPorts = @(\"COM17\", \"COM18\")\n\nforeach ($port in $comPorts) {\n    Write-Host \"Testing $port...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n    \n    try {\n        # Try to open port\n        $portObj = New-Object System.IO.Ports.SerialPort $port, 115200, None, 8, One\n        $portObj.ReadTimeout = 2000\n        $portObj.WriteTimeout = 2000\n        $portObj.Open()\n        \n        Write-Host \"  Port opened successfully\" -ForegroundColor Green\n        \n        # Clear any existing data\n        $portObj.DiscardInBuffer()\n        $portObj.DiscardOutBuffer()\n        \n        # Send PING command\n        Write-Host \"  Sending: PNG\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n        $portObj.WriteLine(\"PNG\")\n        \n        # Wait for response\n        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500\n        \n        # Try to read response\n        $response = \"\"\n        $timeout = 2000\n        $startTime = Get-Date\n        \n        while ((Get-Date) -lt $startTime.AddMilliseconds($timeout)) {\n            if ($portObj.BytesToRead -gt 0) {\n                $response += $portObj.ReadExisting()\n                if ($response -match \"OK\") {\n                    break\n                }\n            }\n            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50\n        }\n        \n        if ($response) {\n            Write-Host \"  Response received: $response\" -ForegroundColor Green\n        } else {\n            Write-Host \"  No response received\" -ForegroundColor Red\n            Write-Host \"    Check:\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n            Write-Host \"    1. Board is powered on\" -ForegroundColor White\n            Write-Host \"    2. RS-485 wiring (A+, B-, GND)\" -ForegroundColor White\n            Write-Host \"    3. Firmware is running\" -ForegroundColor White\n        }\n        \n        $portObj.Close()\n    }\n    catch {\n        Write-Host \"  Error: $($_.Exception.Message)\" -ForegroundColor Red",

        "contents": "async function main() {\n\n    const pingA = await nodeA.ping();\n    if (pingA) {\n      console.log('✓ Node A PING successful');\n    } else {\n      console.error('✗ Node A PING failed - check connection');\n    }\n\n    const pingB = await nodeB.ping();\n    if (pingB) {\n      console.log('✓ Node B PING successful');\n    } else {\n      console.error('✗ Node B PING failed - check connection');\n    }\n\n    if (!pingA || !pingB) {\n      console.error('\\nError: One or both nodes are not responding to PING');\n      console.error('Please check:');\n      console.error('  1. Serial port connections');\n      console.error('  2. RS-485 wiring (A+, B-, GND)');\n      console.error('  3. Board power and firmware');\n      process.exit(1);\n    }\n    console.log('');\n\n    // Run test plan\n    console.log(&#96;Running test plan with ${testPlan.length} test(s)...\\n&#96;);\n    await testRunner.runTestPlan(testPlan);\n\n    console.log('\\nAll tests completed!');\n\n    // Disconnect\n    await nodeA.disconnect();\n    await nodeB.disconnect();\n    testRunner.close();\n\n    process.exit(0);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Fatal error:', error);\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n}\n\n// Handle graceful shutdown\nprocess.on('SIGTERM',",

        "contents": "async function testPort(portPath) {\n  console.log(&#96;\\n${'='.repeat(60)}&#96;);\n  console.log(&#96;Testing ${portPath}&#96;);\n  console.log('='.repeat(60));\n\n  const results = [];\n\n  for (const baudRate of BAUD_RATES) {\n    process.stdout.write(&#96;Testing ${baudRate.toString().padStart(7)} baud... &#96;);\n    const result = await testBaudRate(portPath, baudRate);\n    \n    if (result.error) {\n      console.log(&#96;❌ Error: ${result.error}&#96;);\n      results.push({ baudRate, status: 'error', error: result.error });\n    } else {\n      const hasData = result.receivedData.length &gt; 0 || result.rawHexData.length &gt; 0;\n      \n      if (hasData) {\n        // Analyze hex data\n        const analysis = analyzeHexData(result.rawHexData);\n        \n        // Check for firmware messages\n        const hasFirmwareMsg = result.receivedData.some(msg =&gt; \n          msg.includes('Firmware') || \n          msg.includes('UART0') || \n          msg.includes('initialized') ||\n          msg.includes('OK PONG') ||\n          msg.includes('Node Type')\n        );\n        \n        if (hasFirmwareMsg &amp;&amp; !analysis.isCorrupted) {\n          console.log(&#96;✅ GOOD - Firmware messages detected&#96;);\n          results.push({ baudRate, status: 'good', data: result.receivedData, hex: result.rawHexData });\n        } else if (hasFirmwareMsg &amp;&amp; analysis.isCorrupted) {\n          console.log(&#96;⚠️  PARTIAL - Firmware messages but corrupted hex&#96;);\n          results.push({ baudRate, status: 'partial', data: result.receivedData, hex: result.rawHexData, analysis });\n        } else if (analysis.isCorrupted) {\n          console.log(&#96;❌ CORRUPTED - Hex data shows corruption patterns&#96;);\n          results.push({ baudRate, status: 'corrupted', hex: result.rawHexData, analysis });\n        } else {\n          console.log(&#96;⚠️  UNKNOWN - Data received but unclear&#96;);\n          results.push({ baudRate, status: 'unknown', data: result.receivedData, hex: result.rawHexData });\n        }\n      } else {\n        console.log(&#96;⚪ NO DATA&#96;);\n        results.push({ baudRate, status: 'nodata' });\n      }\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "import { getConfig } from './config.js';\nimport { RS485Comm } from './rs485Comm.js';\nimport { NodeController } from './nodeController.js';\nimport { CSVLogger } from './csvLogger.js';\nimport { TestRunner } from './testRunner.js';\n\n/**\n * Main Orchestrator Entry Point\n * Runs test plan from command line\n */\nasync function main() {\n  console.log('UWB Test Orchestrator Starting...\\n');\n\n  try {\n    // Load configuration\n    const config = getConfig();\n    config.loadSettings();\n    config.loadTestPlan();\n\n    const serialConfig = config.getSerialConfig();\n    const testPlan = config.getTestPlan();\n\n    if (testPlan.length === 0) {\n      console.error('No tests found in test plan');\n      process.exit(1);\n    }\n\n    // Initialize RS-485 connections\n    console.log('Initializing RS-485 connections...');\n    const rs485A = new RS485Comm(\n      serialConfig.node_a_port,\n      serialConfig.baudrate,\n      serialConfig.timeout * 1000\n    );\n    const rs485B = new RS485Comm(\n      serialConfig.node_b_port,\n      serialConfig.baudrate,\n      serialConfig.timeout * 1000\n    );\n\n    // Initialize node controllers\n    const nodeA = new NodeController('A', rs485A);\n    const nodeB = new NodeController('B', rs485B);\n\n    // Initialize CSV logger\n    const csvLogger = new CSVLogger();\n\n    // Initialize test runner\n    const testRunner = new TestRunner(nodeA, nodeB, csvLogger, config);\n\n    // Connect to nodes in parallel for faster startup\n    console.log('Connecting to nodes...');\n    const [connectedA, connectedB] = await Promise.all([\n      nodeA.connect().then(() =&gt; {\n        console.log('Node A connected');\n        return true;\n      }),\n      nodeB.connect().then(() =&gt; {\n        console.log('Node B connected');\n        return true;\n      })\n    ]);\n    console.log('');\n\n    // Test connectivity with PING\n    console.log('Testing connectivity...');\n    const pingA = await nodeA.ping();\n    if (pingA) {\n      console.log('✓ Node A PING successful');\n    }\n}",
